messages.Booking confirmation: Hey {name}, you're booked for a {service} on {date} at {time}. Reply C to confirm. See you in the chair!
messages.Deposit request: Hey {name}, to lock in your spot on {date} I take a ${deposit} deposit. It comes off your total. Send it via {method} and you're set.
messages.Day-before reminder: Reminder: {service} tomorrow at {time}. If anything changes, give me a heads up so I can open the spot for someone else.
messages.No-show policy: Just a heads up: missed appointments without 24 hours' notice keep the deposit. Thanks for understanding, it keeps my chair running.
messages.Rebook nudge: Hey {name}, it's been about 3 weeks since your last cut. Want me to hold a spot for you this week?
messages.Thank you + review: Thanks for coming in today {name}! If you liked the cut, a quick review or a tag on Instagram helps me a ton.
